rows.behavior: When docs/ or .okf/ is a symlink to a folder outside the repository, kmctl verify on a page kmctl review due lists there writes its entry and names the page by its path inside the repository (as review due does), instead of raising ValueError.
rows.fails_when: verify raises, writes nothing, or names the page by a path outside the repository

rows.behavior: The full suite and every tier pass.
rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
